items.title: Revolut Starts EURR Rollout With Bridge as Regulated Issuer
items.summary: Revolut opens EURR to selected customers in three countries; Bridge reported €374 outstanding, compared with €394.5 million of Circle’s EURC.

items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: South Korea Will Give Every Citizen Free AI Access With Unlimited Tokens
items.summary: Three consortia will run the service, sharing up to 512 Nvidia B200 chips supplied by the state, with beta testing due in September.

items.title: Cronos Produces No Block for 10 Hours as $68.7M From Tectonic Exploit Sits Frozen
items.summary: About $6.29 million reached Ethereum as 2,592 ETH before the pause, while researchers say the rest of the attacker's borrowings never left the frozen chain.
